## Architecture Overview

The `consumererror` package in `opentelemetry-collector/consumer/consumererror/` defines error types for the OTel Collector pipeline. Key files: `permanent.go` (NewPermanent/IsPermanent), `downstream.go` (NewDownstream/IsDownstream), `signalerrors.go` (Traces/Logs/Metrics signal-specific errors with Data() accessors), `internal/retryable.go` (Retryable[V] generic type). Changing to a structured ErrorData type breaks all code using IsPermanent(), IsDownstream(), errors.As() with signal errors, and Data() extraction.

## Detailed Analysis

### Core Package

- **`consumererror/permanent.go`** — Defines NewPermanent() and IsPermanent() for non-retryable errors.
- **`consumererror/downstream.go`** — Defines NewDownstream() and IsDownstream() for downstream errors.
- **`consumererror/signalerrors.go`** — Signal-specific error types (Traces, Logs, Metrics) with NewTraces/NewLogs/NewMetrics and Data() accessors.
- **`consumererror/error.go`** — Error struct with NewOTLPHTTPError, NewOTLPGRPCError, ToHTTPStatus, ToGRPCStatus.
- **`consumererror/internal/retryable.go`** — Retryable[V] generic type with Data() method.

### Critical Type-Assert/Unwrap Sites

- **`exporter/exporterhelper/internal/retry_sender.go`** — Uses `consumererror.IsPermanent(err)` for retry decisions.
- **`exporter/exporterhelper/internal/queuebatch/logs.go`** — `errors.As(err, &logError)` then `logError.Data()` for partial retry.
- **`exporter/exporterhelper/internal/queuebatch/traces.go`** — Same pattern for traces.
- **`exporter/exporterhelper/internal/queuebatch/metrics.go`** — Same pattern for metrics.
- **`service/internal/obsconsumer/traces.go`** — `consumererror.IsDownstream(err)` for telemetry attribute routing.
- **`service/internal/obsconsumer/logs.go`** — Same IsDownstream() pattern.
- **`service/internal/obsconsumer/metrics.go`** — Same IsDownstream() pattern.

### OTel Collector Contrib

- **`internal/coreinternal/consumerretry/logs.go`** — Both IsPermanent() and errors.As() with Data() for partial retry.
- **`exporter/zipkinexporter/zipkin.go`** — Wraps errors with consumererror.NewPermanent().
- **`exporter/kafkaexporter/kafka_exporter.go`** — Kafka export error handling.
- **`receiver/kafkareceiver/kafka_receiver.go`** — Kafka consumer error handling.
- **`receiver/zipkinreceiver/trace_receiver.go`** — Returns permanent errors.
